findings.claim: Several change-level acceptance criteria require tests to prove behavior even though the plan later states every change will land uncertified with no testing run.
findings.evidence: c001 says "Done when: ... a test proves runtime B hydrating leaves runtime A's pending actions intact"; c002 says "Done when: a test proves no persistence write lands after the disposal promise resolves"; c003 says "Done when: ... a test simulating an interruption..."; but the Verification posture says "no testing runs until all code is written" and "Every change above therefore lands implemented and type-checked but uncertified."
findings.suggested_fix: Make the per-change acceptance criteria consistent with the directive: either require tests to be authored but not executed for DONE, with a separate certification change after all code is written, or change the verification posture so tests run before each change can be marked done.

findings.claim: The plan maps G3 to c003 but moves part of G3's required exit behavior, must_refetch stale-row removal, into c004 without reflecting that split in the gap/dependency table or c003 acceptance criteria.
findings.evidence: Goals G3 Exit requires: "Electric's `must_refetch` rebuilds the affected replica generation and removes stale rows rather than merging a new snapshot into old data." The plan table maps c003 to "G3", but c003's Done when only covers rows/checkpoint atomicity. The must_refetch behavior appears later under c004: "Handle `must_refetch`: rebuild the affected replica generation and remove stale rows..."
findings.suggested_fix: Either add must_refetch handling and acceptance criteria to c003, or explicitly split G3 across c003 and c004 in the table so c003 is not treated as fully satisfying G3.
